_comment: Mode-specific rules inserted into image_qc.md as $mode_rules.
enhance: This is a quality-only pass on the REFERENCE image. The CANDIDATE must depict exactly the same content: identical text, numbers, dates, names, people, objects, logos and watermarks. Only sharpness, noise, exposure and color may differ.
localize: The CANDIDATE is the REFERENCE image with its text translated into $language_name. Layout, people, objects, logos and watermarks must be unchanged. Every number, unit, date and proper name must be identical to the REFERENCE; the translation must be faithful and add nothing.
regenerate: A NEW original information card or illustration. A source reference may be shown for factual verification only; do not require matching its composition, people or promotional overlays. All explanatory text must be in $language_name. Keep factual brand/product names, identifiers, numbers, dates, qualifications and meaning accurate. Only source-supported brands/logos are allowed, without altering brand relationships. No channel overlays or promotion, realistic likeness of real people, or documentary/news photographs.
promotion_cleanup: PERMISSION-SCOPED EDIT ONLY. Remove ONLY the explicitly listed promotional overlays in the cleanup contract. Copyright notices, source/media-rights marks, author and photographer signatures are protected everywhere, including source URLs/handles. Keep subject, composition, original text, numbers, dates, products/models, UI, proportions, style and original text language unchanged. Only the permitted promotion regions may differ. A missing original promotional mark is lawful ONLY when its exact region is listed and editing rights + explicit removal are confirmed. This is NOT watermark stripping. Do not fail merely because a listed promotion existed in the source and is now absent. watermarks_ok remains false for any unauthorized protected-mark removal.
